data.explanation: Your landlord's agency had the kitchen and bathroom professionally cleaned after you moved out and is asking you to reimburse the €240.00 cost. Pay this amount by the deadline shown, using the IBAN given, so your deposit can be returned to you in full. If you disagree that cleaning was necessary or that this cost is justified under your tenancy agreement, contact the agency before paying, as the letter does not mention any formal objection process. Keep proof of payment for your records.
